meanings.usage: 用于指示方位，常与be动词连用
表示感谢，比thank you更口语化

phrases.usage: 冰淇淋（物质名词，加 a/基数词表一份/一客）

grammar.title: there + be 结构（存在句）
grammar.structure: There is / There are + 名词（+ 地点）
grammar.definition: there + be 表示「有/存在」，实际主语是 be 后面的名词。单数用 is，复数用 are。There's 是 There is 的缩略。说 There's an ice cream man 比 An ice cream man is there 更自然，因为把新信息置于句末强调。
grammar.usage: 说明或询问人、物等的存在，常把新信息放句末。

examples.en: There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.

grammar.title: 人称代词与 be
grammar.definition: 系动词 be 随人称变化：I am, you/we/they are, he/she/it is。缩略：we are not = we aren't = we're not，they are not = they aren't = they're not。

imitations.en: There's a book on the desk.
There are three children in the room.
Here you are. Enjoy your meal.
Here you are, sir. Your coffee.

title: Tired and thirsty / Look at them.
subtitle: 又累又渴。/ 瞧他们。

lead.question: 孩子们玩累了、渴了，妈妈会怎么安置他们，又用什么办法让他们高兴起来？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一个夏日午后，孩子又累又渴地缠着你，你会先让他们坐下，还是直接给东西吃？新概念这一课把「询问状况—坐下—指给对方看某物—递上冰淇淋」串成一段自然对话。重点不在单词量，而在 There's an ice cream man. 这种「存在句」怎么用。
goals: 能用 What's the matter? 询问「怎么啦 / 出了什么事」
能用 There is / There's … 表示「有 / 存在」（there + be 结构）
能用 Are you all right now? 询问对方是否安好，并用 Yes/No + we are 回答
能用选择疑问句 Are they A or B? 二选一（第 20 课操练）
lead.summary: 第 19 课是母子/母女间的日常对话：孩子喊累喊渴，妈妈让坐下、问好些没，指着卖冰淇淋的小贩说 There's an ice cream man，买两份递给孩子，最后确认「现在好了吗」。核心语法是 there + be 存在句（There's = There is）和人称代词与 be 的搭配。第 20 课把 Are they A or B? 选择疑问句铺开，用 tired/thirsty、cold/hot 等成对的形容词操练十组。
lead.tips: ① There's = There is，表示「有/存在」，实际主语是 be 后面的名词，所以 There's an ice cream man 比 An ice cream man is there 更自然；② ice cream 是物质名词，前面加 a/基数词表示「一份/一客」：Two ice creams please；③ What's the matter? 相当于 What's wrong?，特指某人可加 with：What's the matter with you?；④ 选择疑问句 Are they tired or thirsty? 不答 yes/no，要二选一：They're not tired. They're thirsty.

questions.q: Why do the children thank their mother?
questions.zh: 孩子们为什么向母亲致谢？
questions.a: Because she buys them ice creams.
questions.aZh: 因为她给他们买了冰淇淋。
questions.hint: 听对话最后：Two ice creams please. / Thanks, Mum.

questions.q: What do the children say when the mother first asks what's the matter?
questions.zh: 妈妈问「怎么啦」时孩子们怎么说？
questions.a: We are tired and thirsty, Mum.

questions.q: What does the mother point out to the children?
questions.zh: 妈妈指给孩子们看的是什么？
questions.hint: 听 There's an ice cream man.

questions.q: Are the children all right after they sit down?
questions.zh: 孩子们坐下后就好些了吗？
questions.a: No, they aren't. / Yes, they are after the ice creams.
questions.aZh: 坐下时还没有；吃完冰淇淋后才好。
questions.hint: 第一次 Are you all right now? 答 No, we aren't.；最后答 Yes, we are.

questions.q: Why does the book use 'There's an ice cream man' instead of 'An ice cream man is there'?
questions.zh: 为什么用 There's an ice cream man 而不用 An ice cream man is there？
questions.a: There + be puts the new information (an ice cream man) at the end for emphasis; it is the more natural word order in English.
questions.aZh: there + be 把新信息放在句末强调，是英语更自然的语序。
questions.hint: 想一想中文「有个卖冰淇淋的」也是把「卖冰淇淋的」放最后。

questions.q: Are the children tired or thirsty? — They aren't tired. They're thirsty. / Are the postmen cold or hot? — They aren't cold. They're hot.
questions.zh: 第 20 课操练：他们是……还是……？（把成对形容词挨个问一遍，二选一）
questions.a: Are the shoes small or big? — They aren't small. They're big.
questions.aZh: 鞋子是小还是大？——它们不小，是大的。
questions.hint: 选择疑问句不答 yes/no，要否定前者、肯定后者。

exercises.note: What's the matter? = What's wrong? 询问发生什么事；matter 前不加 the。

exercises.q: 用 there is 改写：An ice cream man is there.
exercises.note: there + be 把存在物放句末更自然。
并列形容词用 and 连接；tired/thirsty 后接 Mum 称呼。

exercises.q: 回答 Are you all right now?（否定，孩子们说）
exercises.note: 用 we 指代听话的孩子们，aren't = are not。

exercises.q: 汉译英：请拿两份冰淇淋。
exercises.note: ice cream 物质名词，加基数词表示「一份/一客」。

exercises.q: 完成选择疑问句回答：Are the hairdressers thin or fat?
exercises.note: 二选一，否定前者肯定后者，不用 yes/no。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这些冰淇淋真好吃。
exercises.note: these 接复数，nice 形容词「好吃的」。

quiz.q: "There's an ice cream man." 中 There's 是：
quiz.note: There's = There is，表示「有/存在」，主语 an ice cream man 单数。

quiz.zh: 询问出了什么事怎么说？
quiz.note: What's the matter? = What's wrong? 询问发生什么事；matter 前不加 the。

quiz.q: "We are tired and thirsty." 的主语 we 配 be 动词：
quiz.zh: we 应该配哪个 be 动词？
quiz.note: we/you/they 配 are；I 配 am；he/she/it 配 is。

quiz.q: 选择疑问句 "Are the children tired or thirsty?" 该怎么答？
quiz.note: 选择疑问句二选一，不答 yes/no。

quiz.q: "Two ice creams please." 中 ice cream 前用 two 表示：
quiz.zh: two ice creams 是什么意思？
quiz.note: 物质名词 ice cream 前加基数词表示「一份/一客」。

quiz.q: 回答 "Are you all right now?"（肯定，孩子们说）：
quiz.note: 用 we 指代听话的孩子们，句末简略回答写全 Yes, we are.
